name: Being A Disciple
overview: Being a disciple involves a committed response to Jesus' call to follow Him, as He promises to transform His followers into 'fishers of men' and to empower them through His authority. True discipleship requires self-denial, daily taking up one's cross, and faithfully following Jesus, reflecting the humility and obedience exemplified by the Master. Additionally, disciples are called to make others into disciples through teaching and baptism, extending Christ's kingdom to all nations under His sovereign power.
